description: Data Roadmap is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Data Roadmap provides our current plan for our intended publications and work related to our Open Data Portal over the coming months. Please note the dates are indicative and could be subject to change. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Net Zero Future, Connecting Demand, Connecting Generation. Its keywords are Open Data Function. The portal shows 2026-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
